notes:
# Update from your phone {iphone}
When a new RecordLah is out, your phone says so, shows what's new, and can
update your Mac for you. It waits if anything is recording.

# Bad meeting links stop straight away {link}
If Zoom says a meeting ID isn't valid, RecordLah stops at once and tells
your phone why, instead of waiting 20 minutes.

# Record your screen from your phone {display}
Start a recording of your Mac's whole screen from the phone, with or
without your voice.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Watching a recording from your phone works after you've watched the camera.
- A very short recording with nothing said ends straight away.
- Record now opens its question faster.
- The Mac's live card says when a phone is watching the camera.
- A copy button sits beside the phone pairing code.
- Installing an update is no longer held up by the Guard this Mac prompt.
